verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כִּשְׁמֹ֖עַ יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ חָצ֑וֹר וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֶל־ יוֹבָב֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מָד֔וֹן וְאֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ שִׁמְר֖וֹן וְאֶל־ מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָֽׁף׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ yā·ḇîn me·leḵ- ḥā·ṣō·wr way·yiš·laḥ ’el- yō·w·ḇāḇ me·leḵ mā·ḏō·wn wə·’el- me·leḵ šim·rō·wn wə·’el- me·leḵ ’aḵ·šāp̄
verses.literal: Now when Jabin king of Hazor heard about these things he sent word to Jobab king of Madon to the kings of Shimron . . . . . . and Achshaph
verses.literalPt: SUCEDEU depois disto que, ouvindo-o Jabim, rei de Hazor, enviou mensageiros a Jobabe, rei de Madom, e ao rei de Sinrom, e ao rei de Acsafe;

verses.original: וְֽאֶל־ הַמְּלָכִ֞ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִצְּפ֗וֹן בָּהָ֧ר וּבָעֲרָבָ֛ה נֶ֥גֶב כִּֽנֲר֖וֹת וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֑ה וּבְנָפ֥וֹת דּ֖וֹר מִיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer miṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·wn bā·hār ū·ḇā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ne·ḡeḇ ki·nă·rō·wṯ ū·ḇaš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇə·nā·p̄ō·wṯ dō·wr mî·yām
verses.literal: to the kings of the north in the mountains in the Arabah south of Chinnereth in the foothills and in Naphoth-dor . . . to the west
verses.literalPt: E aos reis, que estavam ao norte, nas montanhas, e na campina para o sul de Quinerete, e nas planícies, e nas elevações de Dor, do lado do mar;

verses.original: הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מִמִּזְרָ֣ח וּמִיָּ֔ם וְהָאֱמֹרִ֧י וְהַחִתִּ֛י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֥י וְהַיְבוּסִ֖י בָּהָ֑ר וְהַֽחִוִּי֙ תַּ֣חַת חֶרְמ֔וֹן בְּאֶ֖רֶץ הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî mim·miz·rāḥ ū·mî·yām wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·hay·ḇū·sî bā·hār wə·ha·ḥiw·wî ta·ḥaṯ ḥer·mō·wn bə·’e·reṣ ham·miṣ·pāh
verses.literal: to the Canaanites in the east and west to the Amorites Hittites Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country and to the Hivites at the foot of Hermon in the land of Mizpah
verses.literalPt: Ao cananeu do oriente e do ocidente; e ao amorreu, e ao heteu, e ao perizeu, e ao jebuseu nas montanhas; e ao heveu ao pé de Hermom, na terra de Mizpá.

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֣וּ הֵ֗ם וְכָל־ מַֽחֲנֵיהֶם֙ עִמָּ֔ם עַם־ רָ֕ב כַּח֛וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ שְׂפַת־ הַיָּ֖ם לָרֹ֑ב וְס֥וּס וָרֶ֖כֶב רַב־ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū hêm wə·ḵāl ma·ḥă·nê·hem ‘im·mām ‘am- rāḇ ka·ḥō·wl ’ă·šer ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ- hay·yām lā·rōḇ wə·sūs wā·re·ḵeḇ raḇ- mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: So these kings came out with all their armies a multitude as numerous as the sand on the seashore . . . along with a great number . . . of horses and chariots
verses.literalPt: Saíram pois estes, e todos os seus exércitos com eles, muito povo, em multidão como a areia que está na praia do mar; e muitíssimos cavalos e carros.

verses.original: וַיִּוָּ֣עֲד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ יַחְדָּו֙ אֶל־ מֵ֣י מֵר֔וֹם לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiw·wā·‘ă·ḏū kōl ham·mə·lā·ḵîm hā·’êl·leh way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·ya·ḥă·nū yaḥ·dāw ’el- mê mê·rō·wm lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: All these kings joined forces and encamped at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel
verses.literalPt: Todos estes reis se ajuntaram, e vieram e se acamparam junto às águas de Merom, para pelejarem contra Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֣ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ אַל־ תִּירָ֣א מִפְּנֵיהֶם֒ כִּֽי־ מָחָ֞ר כָּעֵ֣ת הַזֹּ֗את אָנֹכִ֞י נֹתֵ֧ן אֶת־ כֻּלָּ֛ם חֲלָלִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת־ סוּסֵיהֶ֣ם תְּעַקֵּ֔ר וְאֶת־ מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’al- tî·rā mip·pə·nê·hem kî- mā·ḥār kā·‘êṯ haz·zōṯ ’ā·nō·ḵî nō·ṯên ’eṯ- kul·lām ḥă·lā·lîm lip̄·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- sū·sê·hem tə·‘aq·qêr wə·’eṯ- mar·kə·ḇō·ṯê·hem tiś·rōp̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Joshua Do not be afraid of them for by this time tomorrow I will deliver all of them slain before Israel You are to hamstring their horses and burn up . . . their chariots
verses.literalPt: E disse o SENHOR a Josué: Não temas diante deles; porque amanhã, a esta mesma hora, eu os darei todos feridos diante dos filhos de Israel; os seus cavalos jarretarás, e os seus carros queimarás a fogo.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ וְכָל־ עַם֩ הַמִּלְחָמָ֨ה עִמּ֧וֹ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם עַל־ מֵ֥י מֵר֖וֹם פִּתְאֹ֑ם וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·ḵāl ‘am ham·mil·ḥā·māh ‘im·mōw ‘ă·lê·hem ‘al- mê mê·rō·wm piṯ·’ōm way·yip·pə·lū bā·hem
verses.literal: So by the waters of Merom Joshua and his whole army . . . . . . came upon them suddenly and attacked them
verses.literalPt: E Josué, e todos os homens de guerra com ele, veio apressadamente sobre eles às águas de Merom, e atacou-os de repente.

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנֵ֨ם יְהוָ֥ה בְּיַֽד־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ וַיַּכּוּם֒ וַֽיִּרְדְּפ֞וּם עַד־ צִיד֣וֹן רַבָּ֗ה וְעַד֙ מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת מַ֔יִם וְעַד־ בִּקְעַ֥ת מִצְפֶּ֖ה מִזְרָ֑חָה וַיַּכֻּ֕ם עַד־ בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר־ לָהֶ֖ם שָׂרִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tə·nêm Yah·weh bə·yaḏ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kūm way·yir·də·p̄ūm ‘aḏ- ṣî·ḏō·wn rab·bāh wə·‘aḏ miś·rə·p̄ō·wṯ ma·yim wə·‘aḏ- biq·‘aṯ miṣ·peh miz·rā·ḥāh way·yak·kum ‘aḏ- bil·tî hiš·’îr- lā·hem śā·rîḏ
verses.literal: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Israel who struck them down and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon and Misrephoth-maim and eastward as far as . . . . . . the Valley of Mizpeh They struck them down . . . leaving no survivors
verses.literalPt: E o SENHOR os deu nas mãos de Israel; e eles os feriram, e os perseguiram até à grande Sidom, e até Misrefote-Maim, e até ao vale de Mizpá ao oriente; feriram até não lhes deixarem nenhum.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לָהֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָֽמַר־ ל֖וֹ יְהוָ֑ה אֶת־ סוּסֵיהֶ֣ם עִקֵּ֔ר וְאֶת־ מַרְכְּבֹתֵיהֶ֖ם שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lā·hem yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ka·’ă·šer ’ā·mar- lōw Yah·weh ’eṯ- sū·sê·hem ‘iq·qêr wə·’eṯ- mar·kə·ḇō·ṯê·hem śā·rap̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: Joshua treated them as the LORD had told him he hamstrung their horses and burned up . . . their chariots
verses.literalPt: E fez-lhes Josué como o SENHOR lhe dissera; os seus cavalos jarretou, e os seus carros queimou a fogo.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨שָׁב יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ וַיִּלְכֹּ֣ד אֶת־ חָצ֔וֹר וְאֶת־ מַלְכָּ֖הּ הִכָּ֣ה בֶחָ֑רֶב כִּֽי־ חָצ֣וֹר לְפָנִ֔ים הִ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ כָּל־ הַמַּמְלָכ֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bā·‘êṯ ha·hî way·yil·kōḏ ’eṯ- ḥā·ṣō·wr wə·’eṯ- mal·kāh hik·kāh ḇe·ḥā·reḇ kî- ḥā·ṣō·wr lə·p̄ā·nîm hî rōš kāl- ham·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword because Hazor was formerly the head of all these kingdoms
verses.literalPt: E naquele mesmo tempo voltou Josué, e tomou a Hazor, e feriu à espada ao seu rei; porquanto Hazor antes era a cabeça de todos estes reinos.

verses.original: וַ֠יַּכּוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֨פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֤הּ לְפִי־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ הַֽחֲרֵ֔ם לֹ֥א נוֹתַ֖ר כָּל־ נְשָׁמָ֑ה וְאֶת־ חָצ֖וֹר שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kū ’eṯ- kāl- han·ne·p̄eš ’ă·šer- bāh lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ ha·ḥă·rêm lō nō·w·ṯar kāl- nə·šā·māh wə·’eṯ- ḥā·ṣō·wr śā·rap̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: The Israelites put everyone . . . in Hazor . . . to the sword devoting them to destruction Nothing that breathed remained and Joshua burned down . . . Hazor itself
verses.literalPt: E a todos os que nela estavam, feriram ao fio da espada, e totalmente os destruíram; nada restou do que tinha fôlego, e a Hazor queimou a fogo.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ כָּל־ עָרֵ֣י הַמְּלָכִֽים־ הָ֠אֵלֶּה וְֽאֶת־ כָּל־ מַלְכֵיהֶ֞ם לָכַ֧ד יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ וַיַּכֵּ֥ם לְפִי־ חֶ֖רֶב הֶחֱרִ֣ים אוֹתָ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- ‘ā·rê ham·mə·lā·ḵîm- hā·’êl·leh wə·’eṯ- kāl- mal·ḵê·hem lā·ḵaḏ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·yak·kêm lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ he·ḥĕ·rîm ’ō·w·ṯām ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh
verses.literal: Joshua captured all these - . . . kings and their cities and put them . . . to the sword He devoted them to destruction as Moses the LORD’s servant had commanded
verses.literalPt: E Josué tomou todas as cidades destes reis, e todos os seus reis, e os feriu ao fio da espada, destruindo-os totalmente, como ordenara Moisés servo do SENHOR.

verses.original: רַ֣ק כָּל־ הֶעָרִ֗ים הָעֹֽמְדוֹת֙ עַל־ תִּלָּ֔ם לֹ֥א שְׂרָפָ֖ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל זוּלָתִ֛י אֶת־ חָצ֥וֹר לְבַדָּ֖הּ שָׂרַ֥ף יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: raq kāl- he·‘ā·rîm hā·‘ō·mə·ḏō·wṯ ‘al- til·lām lō śə·rā·p̄ām yiś·rā·’êl zū·lā·ṯî ’eṯ- ḥā·ṣō·wr lə·ḇad·dāh śā·rap̄ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘
verses.literal: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds except Hazor . . . which Joshua burned
verses.literalPt: Tão-somente não queimaram os israelitas as cidades que estavam sobre os seus outeiros; a não ser Hazor, a qual Josué queimou.

verses.original: וְ֠כֹל שְׁלַ֞ל הֶעָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וְהַבְּהֵמָ֔ה בָּזְז֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֣ק אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הָאָדָ֞ם הִכּ֣וּ לְפִי־ חֶ֗רֶב עַד־ הִשְׁמִדָם֙ אוֹתָ֔ם לֹ֥א הִשְׁאִ֖ירוּ כָּל־ נְשָׁמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl šə·lal he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh wə·hab·bə·hê·māh bā·zə·zū lā·hem bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl raq ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·ḏām hik·kū lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ ‘aḏ- hiš·mi·ḏām ’ō·w·ṯām lō hiš·’î·rū kāl- nə·šā·māh
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . took for themselves . . . all the plunder and livestock of these cities but they put . . . all the people to the sword until they had completely destroyed them not sparing anyone who breathed
verses.literalPt: E todos os despojos destas cidades, e o gado, os filhos de Israel tomaram para si; tão-somente a todos os homens feriram ao fio da espada, até que os destruíram; nada do que tinha fôlego deixaram com vida.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדּ֔וֹ כֵּן־ צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֵן֙ עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ לֹֽא־ הֵסִ֣יר דָּבָ֔ר מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh ‘aḇ·dōw kên- ṣiw·wāh mō·šeh ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·ḵên ‘ā·śāh yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lō- hê·sîr dā·ḇār mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: As the LORD had commanded His servant Moses so Moses commanded Joshua That is what Joshua did leaving nothing . . . undone of all that the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Como ordenara o SENHOR a Moisés, seu servo, assim Moisés ordenou a Josué; e assim Josué o fez; nem uma só palavra tirou de tudo o que o SENHOR ordenara a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֗את הָהָ֤ר וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ הַגֹּ֔שֶׁן וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְאֶת־ הַ֥ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּשְׁפֵלָתֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ hā·hār wə·’eṯ- kāl- han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·’êṯ kāl- ’e·reṣ hag·gō·šen wə·’eṯ- haš·šə·p̄ê·lāh wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh wə·’eṯ- har yiś·rā·’êl ū·šə·p̄ê·lā·ṯōh
verses.literal: So Joshua took this entire region the hill country all the Negev all the land of Goshen the western foothills the Arabah and the mountains of Israel and their foothills
verses.literalPt: Assim Josué tomou toda aquela terra, as montanhas, e todo o sul, e toda a terra de Gósen, e as planícies, e as campinas, e as montanhas de Israel, e as suas planícies.

verses.original: מִן־ הָהָ֤ר הֶֽחָלָק֙ הָעוֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעַד־ בַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן תַּ֖חַת הַר־ חֶרְמ֑וֹן וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ לָכַ֔ד וַיַּכֵּ֖ם וַיְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: min- hā·hār he·ḥā·lāq hā·‘ō·w·leh śê·‘îr wə·‘aḏ- ba·‘al gāḏ bə·ḇiq·‘aṯ hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ta·ḥaṯ har- ḥer·mō·wn wə·’êṯ kāl- mal·ḵê·hem lā·ḵaḏ way·yak·kêm way·mî·ṯêm
verses.literal: from Mount Halak which rises toward Seir as far as Baal-gad in the Valley of Lebanon at the foot of Mount Hermon He captured all their kings and struck them down putting them to death
verses.literalPt: Desde o monte Halaque, que sobe a Seir, até Baal-Gade, no vale do Líbano, ao pé do monte de Hermom; também tomou todos os seus reis, e os feriu e os matou.

verses.original: יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים עָשָׂ֧ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמְּלָכִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·mîm rab·bîm ‘ā·śāh yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- kāl- ham·mə·lā·ḵîm hā·’êl·leh mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Joshua . . . waged war against all these kings for a long period of time
verses.literalPt: Por muito tempo Josué fez guerra contra todos estes reis.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ הָיְתָ֣ה עִ֗יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִשְׁלִ֙ימָה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלְתִּ֥י הַחִוִּ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן אֶת־ הַכֹּ֖ל לָקְח֥וּ בַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- hā·yə·ṯāh ‘îr ’ă·šer hiš·lî·māh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bil·tî ha·ḥiw·wî yō·šə·ḇê ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn ’eṯ- hak·kōl lā·qə·ḥū ḇam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: No . . . city made peace with the Israelites . . . except the Hivites living in Gibeon all others were taken in battle
verses.literalPt: Não houve cidade que fizesse paz com os filhos de Israel, senão os heveus, moradores de Gibeom; por guerra as tomaram todas.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה׀ הָיְתָ֡ה לְחַזֵּ֣ק אֶת־ לִבָּם֩ לִקְרַ֨את הַמִּלְחָמָ֤ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְמַ֣עַן הַֽחֲרִימָ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֥י הֱיוֹת־ לָהֶ֖ם תְּחִנָּ֑ה כִּ֚י לְמַ֣עַן הַשְׁמִידָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî mê·’êṯ Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ḥaz·zêq ’eṯ- lib·bām liq·raṯ ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·ma·‘an ha·ḥă·rî·mām lə·ḇil·tî hĕ·yō·wṯ- lā·hem tə·ḥin·nāh kî lə·ma·‘an haš·mî·ḏām ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh
verses.literal: For it was of the LORD to harden their hearts to engage Israel . . . in battle . . . so that they would be set apart for destruction and would receive . . . no mercy - being annihilated as the LORD had commanded Moses
verses.literalPt: Porquanto do SENHOR vinha o endurecimento de seus corações, para saírem à guerra contra Israel, para que fossem totalmente destruídos e não achassem piedade alguma; mas para os destruir a todos como o SENHOR tinha ordenado a Moisés.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא וַיַּכְרֵ֤ת אֶת־ הָֽעֲנָקִים֙ מִן־ הָהָ֤ר מִן־ חֶבְרוֹן֙ מִן־ דְּבִ֣ר מִן־ עֲנָ֔ב וּמִכֹּל֙ הַ֣ר יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמִכֹּ֖ל הַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עִם־ עָרֵיהֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִימָ֥ם יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bā·‘êṯ ha·hî way·yaḵ·rêṯ ’eṯ- hā·‘ă·nā·qîm min- hā·hār min- ḥeḇ·rō·wn min- də·ḇir min- ‘ă·nāḇ ū·mik·kōl har yə·hū·ḏāh ū·mik·kōl har yiś·rā·’êl ‘im- ‘ā·rê·hem he·ḥĕ·rî·mām yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘
verses.literal: At that time Joshua proceeded to eliminate the Anakim from the hill country . . . of Hebron . . . Debir . . . and Anab and from all the hill country of Judah . . . . . . and of Israel Joshua devoted them to destruction along with their cities
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo veio Josué, e extirpou os anaquins das montanhas de Hebrom, de Debir, de Anabe e de todas as montanhas de Judá e de todas as montanhas de Israel; Josué os destruiu totalmente com as suas cidades.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ נוֹתַ֣ר עֲנָקִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֗ק בְּעַזָּ֛ה בְּגַ֥ת וּבְאַשְׁדּ֖וֹד נִשְׁאָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- nō·w·ṯar ‘ă·nā·qîm bə·’e·reṣ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl raq bə·‘az·zāh bə·ḡaṯ ū·ḇə·’aš·dō·wḏ niš·’ā·rū
verses.literal: No Anakim were left in the land of the Israelites only in Gaza Gath and Ashdod did any survive
verses.literalPt: Nenhum dos anaquins foi deixado na terra dos filhos de Israel; somente ficaram alguns em Gaza, em Gate, e em Asdode.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֒ וַיִּתְּנָהּ֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ לְנַחֲלָ֧ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָ֖ם לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָאָ֥רֶץ שָׁקְטָ֖ה מִמִּלְחָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh way·yit·tə·nāh yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lə·na·ḥă·lāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl kə·maḥ·lə·qō·ṯām lə·šiḇ·ṭê·hem wə·hā·’ā·reṣ šā·qə·ṭāh mim·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: So Joshua took the entire land in keeping with all that the LORD . . . had spoken to Moses And Joshua gave it as an inheritance to Israel according to the allotments to their tribes Then the land had rest from war
verses.literalPt: Assim Josué tomou toda esta terra, conforme a tudo o que o SENHOR tinha dito a Moisés; e Josué a deu em herança aos filhos de Israel, conforme as suas divisões, segundo as suas tribos; e a terra descansou da guerra.
